title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the network sends CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND to update UE configuration parameters.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to update UE configuration parameters.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to confirm successful configuration update.

entities.name: Timer T3555
entities.description: Timer used for retransmission of CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI IE
entities.description: Information element containing 5G Globally Unique Temporary Identifier.

entities.name: Updated PEIPS assistance information IE
entities.description: Information element containing updated Paging Early Indication for Power Saving assistance information.

entities.name: Lower layer failure
entities.description: Condition when lower layer failure is detected before CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE is received.

entities.name: Procedure abortion
entities.description: Behavior where the network aborts the ongoing procedure.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate de-registration procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: UE request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of service request.

relations.description: Generic UE configuration update procedure involves sending CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message.
Network starts timer T3555 when sending CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND.
Network resets and starts timer T3555 on first expiry for retransmission.
Fifth expiry of timer T3555 causes procedure abortion.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain 5G-GUTI IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain Updated PEIPS assistance information IE.
Lower layer failure condition affects the generic UE configuration update procedure behavior.
Receipt of DEREGISTRATION REQUEST causes abortion of generic UE configuration update procedure.
Receipt of REGISTRATION REQUEST causes abortion of generic UE configuration update procedure.
Receipt of SERVICE REQUEST with NAS signalling connection release causes abortion of generic UE configuration update procedure.
SERVICE REQUEST message contains UE request type IE.
